ui.voiceInput.title: AI 语音控制
AI voice control
ui.voiceInput.useHint: 按一次开始录音，再按一次结束并识别；静音自动结束可关闭。识别后可自动发送给 AI 操控。
Press once to record, again to finish and recognize. Silence detection and automatic AI submission are optional.
ui.voiceInput.autoSend: 识别后自动交给 AI 执行
ui.voiceInput.showHud: 显示聆听和思考玻璃动画
ui.voiceInput.model: 本地 Whisper 模型文件夹
ui.voiceInput.modelHint: 选择已下载的 CTranslate2 / faster-whisper 模型目录
Select a downloaded CTranslate2 / faster-whisper model directory
ui.voiceInput.windowsHint: Windows 模式使用本机已安装的语音识别语言；缺少识别器时会提示。与界面语言一致不代表系统已安装对应识别器。
Windows mode uses installed speech recognition languages. Missing recognizers are reported; selecting a UI language does not install one.
ui.voiceInput.whisperHint: faster-whisper 需要你选择已有 Python 环境和本地模型；CPU / NVIDIA CUDA 可选，不自动下载或上传音频。
faster-whisper needs an existing Python environment and local model. CPU or NVIDIA CUDA is selectable; audio is not uploaded and models are not downloaded automatically.
ui.voiceInput.privacy: 只有手动触发才录音；换世界、退出或窗口失去焦点会取消。临时录音识别后删除，只有识别文字交给已配置的 AI 接口。录音设置和 API Key 永不进入配置码。

Recording starts only when triggered. World changes, exit or focus loss cancel it. Temporary audio is deleted; only recognized text reaches the configured AI service. Microphone settings and API keys never enter share codes.
ui.voiceInput.reservedKey: 该按键用于打开界面，请选其他按键
This key opens the GUI; choose another key
ui.voiceInput.needKey: 请先在 AI 操控保存 API Key
Save an API key in AI Control first
ui.voiceInput.needModel: 请选择有效的本地 Whisper 模型文件夹
Choose a valid local Whisper model directory
ui.voiceInput.windowsOnly: Windows 识别器仅在 Windows 上可用
ui.voiceInput.rejected: AI 暂未接收，请检查任务和角色状态
AI could not accept this request; check task and player state
ui.voiceInput.recordFailed: 录音失败，请检查麦克风和系统权限
Recording failed; check microphone and system access
ui.voiceInput.recognizeFailed: 本地识别失败，请检查引擎和模型
Local recognition failed; check the engine and model
ui.voiceInput.noLanguage: 未安装对应 Windows 识别器，可换语言或本地 Whisper
No matching Windows recognizer is installed; choose another language or local Whisper
ui.voiceInput.noDependency: 所选 Python 环境未安装 faster-whisper
faster-whisper is missing in the selected Python environment
ui.voiceInput.thinkingHint: 正在等待真实模型回复
ui.voiceInput.hotkeyHint: 再次按录音键结束 · 可在 AI 操控调整设置
Press the recording key again to finish · Settings are in AI Control
